title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027/28
about: Research Grants Council PhD fellowships for study at participating Hong Kong universities. The 2027/28 round offers 400 fellowships; applicants file an initial RGC application, then apply to each chosen university. Results are due in May 2027.
requirements: Initial application to the RGC, then a full application to each chosen participating university before its deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "All research disciplines" (field) / "PhD fellowships" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"PhD applicants" (seniority) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
